why_ai: Licensed inspectors physically walk attics and crawlspaces and are sued over missed defects.
why_clarity: Standards of practice define scope, but missed defects surface only months after closing.
why_digital: Starts from a physical house on site and ends in a written report sold through local agents.

why_ai: Radon, sewer and termite testing need equipment placed and samples taken on site.
why_clarity: Tests produce measured results against published thresholds on near-identical jobs.
why_digital: Physical sampling on site, results returned as separate PDFs to local clients.

why_ai: Certified review appraisers sign off, but AVM-driven and AI review absorbs much desk review.
why_clarity: Reviews check comparable selection and adjustments against defined lender and regulatory rules.
why_digital: Completed appraisal files in, review findings out, all on screens.

why_ai: Inspectors walk every building system on site and carry liability for the condition findings.
why_clarity: ASTM E2018 structures the report, though each commercial building's scope differs.
why_digital: Physical buildings inspected in person, reports written in Word for regional clients.

why_ai: Assessors physically walk each building and their reserve tables go directly into loans.
why_clarity: Repair schedules and reserve tables follow a standard format checked by lenders.
why_digital: On-site building walks produce digital reserve tables for national lenders.

why_ai: Defect spotting is learnable visual pattern recognition, but liability for misses keeps inspectors accountable.
why_clarity: Each photo is a recurring classification, though correctness shows only when defects surface later.
why_digital: Photos and observations of physical homes become digital defect findings.

why_ai: Physical samples need laboratory analysis that no software can perform.
why_clarity: Analytical methods give objective measured results against fixed thresholds.
why_digital: Physical samples shipped in, digital results returned to remote inspectors.

why_ai: Pricing and network analytics on claims data are model-driven desk work.
why_clarity: Claim frequency models are checked against annual renewal experience.
why_digital: Claims data in, pricing models and analyses out.

why_ai: Brand and agent relationships matter, but territory analysis and standards work is routine desk work.
why_clarity: Franchise support spans development, standards and marketing with mixed success measures.
why_digital: Corporate desk work supporting field franchisees, with some in-person development.

why_ai: Software product and data work on a report corpus that AI tools directly exploit.
why_clarity: Templates and defect libraries are defined products with usage-based feedback.
why_digital: Report data and photos in, software and templates out.

why_ai: Licensing renewals mandate their continuing education and certification, which sustains demand.
why_clarity: Standards and exams follow defined cycles with measurable pass rates.
why_digital: Online courses, exams and standards delivered to inspectors nationwide.

why_ai: Insurers carry the risk capital for missed-defect lawsuits, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Annual renewals recur, but lawsuit losses emerge years after the inspection.
why_digital: Applications and claims data in, rating decisions out, remotely.

why_ai: Standardized exterior surveys are high-volume routine work that aerial imagery models replace.
why_clarity: Standardized observation forms are repeated across millions of homes.
why_digital: Field visits to physical homes produce digital reports for remote carriers.

why_ai: Inspectors physically verify each construction phase on site against building code.
why_clarity: Code compliance checklists give a clear pass or fail at each phase.
why_digital: On-site phase inspections with paper checklists for local buyers.

why_ai: On-site licensed inspection plus explaining defects in the buyer's language builds personal trust.
why_clarity: Same standard inspection scope, with missed defects still surfacing late.
why_digital: Physical inspection in person, report delivered in writing to local buyers.

why_ai: Condition scoring from imagery is already computer vision; decades of data archives protect incumbents.
why_clarity: Condition and cost scores for every property are checked against claims and inspections.
why_digital: Imagery and property records in, data feeds out to remote insurers.

why_ai: Narratives follow defect, location, severity and action patterns that LLMs generate from structured inputs.
why_clarity: Every narrative follows the same structure across thousands of reports.
why_digital: Notes and photos in, a written report out, produced on screens.

why_ai: Licensed inspectors evaluate every system on site in two to three hours and carry liability.
why_clarity: Hundreds of similar inspections a year, but misses surface only after move-in.
why_digital: Physical walkthrough in person, digital report sold through local agent referrals.

why_ai: Wells, septic and private electrical service on remote properties need varied on-site expertise.
why_clarity: Well and septic protocols exist, but each rural property's systems differ.
why_digital: Offline field work far from cell service, sold locally by word of mouth.

why_ai: A camera must physically go down the line, though footage interpretation is automatable.
why_clarity: Narrow technical assessments with video evidence on repeated job types.
why_digital: On-site camera work, video and report delivered to local clients.

why_ai: State boards hold statutory licensing and disciplinary authority over inspectors.
why_clarity: Licensing decisions follow statute, while complaint findings need case-by-case review.
why_digital: Applications and complaints are documents, handled by state staff with hearings.

why_ai: A licensed engineer visits the site and stamps the letter that resolves the contingency.
why_clarity: The letter is a defined deliverable, but each foundation or framing question differs.
why_digital: Site visits to local homes, referred by local inspectors.
